title: Passkeys Explained: Sign In Without Typing a Password
headline:
Your face is not
your password.
meaning: Unlock a passkey with your device.
example: The website receives proof, not your fingerprint.
comparison: Password: a shared secret. Passkey: cryptographic proof.
caution: Keep account recovery options up to date.
question: Would you try a passkey?
lines: You unlock your phone with your face. A passkey can let you sign in the same way.
Instead of typing a password, your device uses a cryptographic key to prove the sign-in is yours.
The website sends a challenge. You approve with your fingerprint, face scan, or device pin.
The site receives a signed response, not your fingerprint. Passkeys are designed to resist phishing.
Recovery still matters. Check how your account restores access if your device is lost.
